correctness.rationale: The proof gives an exact block conjugation from each nilpotent base Jordan block of size s to one length-2s unipotent corona block and then to two length-2s primitive-cubic wave blocks. Their orders, fixed-space nullities, and telescoping period counts follow by characteristic-two binomial powers. The block inverse identities prove the necessary condition, and tree matching and even-cube corollaries have separate proofs. Exact GF(2) rank calculations checked all 278 nilpotent-base examples among 1,099 graphs of at most five vertices, and direct independent iteration checked 69,648 states. These checks corroborate, but do not substitute for, the general symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The odd-part criterion characterizes a dynamical property for every finite simple base graph via modular adjacency nilpotence; a complete orbit census then depends only on its nilpotent Jordan partition. The equivalent tree matching-parity condition and sharply different infinite families (paths with unbounded global order versus even cubes with constant order 12) show concrete structural and dynamical value not supplied by the known real-spectrum transfer formula or by small isolated enumerations.
